title: Project
description: Project-level OpenVinci settings — currently just the board target. Lives at the project ROOT (`project.json`), separate from the per-class vendor/as configs under `config/<Module>/<Module>.json` so the vendor toolchain never sees it. Optional; absent = no board target = the per-target generators (e.g. backend/gen/can_h7.py) skip this project.

target.description: Identifier for the silicon the MCAL config will be generated against. `stm32h753zi` is the only target with a generator today (backend/gen/can_h7.py). Absent or null = host-only project (the L2 host-sim case).
